authorization.request: 用户要求优化 DSH Desktop 商城导航留白，增加官方插件与已安装插件两个入口，并继续完善审核建议和必装榜补位说明；此前已明确要求推送、发布与合并。

objective: 改善 DSH Desktop 插件商城导航布局；增加 DSH 官方组件与用户已安装插件只读视图；让审核建议更容易理解，并说明必装榜分类补位及星标数据边界。

change.layout: Marketplace views use a responsive full-width grid, filling available horizontal space and wrapping naturally in narrow panels.
change.inventoryTabs: Official and optional DSH bundles, including @deepseek-ai packages, and non-official installed bundles are separate read-only views sourced from the official Desktop plugin manager inventory. Switching views clears stale filters.
change.reviewAdvice: Translate common Store audit evidence into plain Chinese; preserve the exact technical reason in an expandable detail. Store guidance stays advisory and the DSH Desktop manager decides install results.
change.rankings: Supplemental essential picks show the category and observed star order, count entries whose stars are unknown, and avoid implying that an unverified pick is the category champion.
change.boundary: No DSH core, @deepseek-ai package, real Profile, install/uninstall authority, Loader/Fiber, package installation, or restart behavior is changed in this source PR.

gates: Fresh typed plan binds current origin/main Commit, exact changed-file scope, base SHA-256 preconditions and reviewed postcondition hashes; CI runs the dedicated DSH upgrade-plan verifier.
Disposable Desktop fixtures verify responsive navigation, official versus user-installed inventory, per-view filtering, plain-language audit guidance, and ranking labels.
Run npm run check, package dry-run and git diff --check; require exact-head PR CI before merge.
After source merge, create a separate fresh Catalog policy plan pinned to the merged immutable source Commit and verify GitHub Raw, Pages, dsh.store and dsh-store.cn independently.
Real Desktop UI acceptance is a separate gate after publishing and updating the official Desktop package; tests and Catalog readback do not prove native UI acceptance.
rollback: Revert only this source change through a new auditable CI-checked PR. Keep the current Catalog pin until a separate fresh source-bound Catalog plan passes all policy gates.
healthCheck: Require DSH_UPGRADE_PLAN_OK, 74/74 focused Desktop and ranking tests, npm run check with REGISTRY_OK entries=875 and 594/594 tests, npm run build:marketplace, npm pack --dry-run --json, git diff --check and exact-head PR CI. Verify Catalog public deployment and real Desktop UI separately.
